start: Staff & sign-in as an owner; the gym server keeps job names

steps.action: Tap "Add a person"; type the name and mobile number
user_sees: Question "What is their job?" with Owner, Staff (front desk), Trainer, Other
must_not: "Other" giving more rights than the front desk

user_sees: Hint "Same access as the front desk. The job only shows next to their name."
Box "Type the job (for example Manager, Cleaner)"
must_not: The box shown for Owner, Staff or Trainer

user_sees: Toast "<name> added. Now make a sign-in code for them."
The new row with the pill "Manager"
must_not: The pill reading "Staff" for a person with a job
The person given owner rights

start: Staff & sign-in as an owner; the gym server does not keep job names yet

steps.action: Add a person with "Other" and the job "Manager"
user_sees: The row with the pill "Manager" on this browser
must_not: An error or a failed add because the job could not be saved on the server
Words claiming the job is saved for every device

steps.action: Open the list on another phone or browser
user_sees: The same person with the pill "Staff" (the job is only on the first browser)
must_not: The person missing on the other device

steps.action: Later, once the server keeps job names, open the list on the first browser
user_sees: The job is sent by itself; now every device shows "Manager"
must_not: The kept job sent over a newer job on the server
The job sent for a person who was removed or made an owner

steps.action: Leave the job empty (or only spaces), save
user_sees: "Type their job, like Manager or Cleaner."
must_not: A person added with an empty job pill
A pill that pushes the row's buttons off the screen
The job cut later without a word

user_sees: The pill "Owner" in the muted colour, with front desk rights only: check it cannot be mistaken for a real owner
must_not: A front desk person who looks like an owner in the list

start: Staff & sign-in as an owner; a person has the job "Manager"

steps.action: Look for a way to change the job to "Cleaner" or to clear it
user_sees: A way to edit or clear the job on the person's row
must_not: The only way being to remove the person and add them again
A job that can never be corrected after a typing mistake

user_sees: The pill still shows the typed job
must_not: The job lost by ticking Trainer

steps.action: Remove the person, add them again as "Staff (front desk)"
must_not: The old job coming back from this browser's memory

start: Staff & sign-in as an owner, then as the person with the job

steps.action: Sign in as the "Manager" and open the panel
user_sees: Front desk pages only; the "You" card says "Staff"
must_not: Money totals or owner pages opened by a job name
The job shown to members anywhere
Other gyms' job lists read from this browser's memory on a shared computer
